title: Electro-Mechanical Engineering Technology, B.S. (College of Engineering)
notes: Built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs (raw HTML fetched and cross-checked directly -- not WebFetch's summarized extraction -- because every semester subtotal below was verified to sum to the page's own printed per-term and per-year totals before being trusted). CAMPUS: this year's own 'Begin/End Campus' section reads End Campus = Fayette, New Kensington, York -- Beaver is NOT listed. Diffed against the live 2026-27 bulletin (which lists Beaver, Fayette, New Kensington, York, and is what EMET-2026.json already models) and confirmed Beaver only appears starting with the 2026-27 edition's own Suggested Academic Plan tab; the 2022-23 through 2025-26 archives contain zero 'Beaver Campus' text anywhere on the Suggested Academic Plan tab. So this file's 'campus' field is Fayette/New Kensington/York only, not Beaver-inclusive, unlike 2026. REPRESENTATIVE CAMPUS: since Beaver's plan (the one EMET-2026.json is built from) didn't exist yet, this file is built from Fayette's own posted Suggested Academic Plan instead (picked because it's listed first on the page and because EMET-2026.json's own Technical Elective slot notes already treat Fayette/New Kensington/York as sharing one real, identical elective list -- i.e. Fayette is a fair stand-in for this campus set, the same way Beaver stands in for the 2026 file). TWO PLAN VARIANTS existed within the 2022-23 edition itself, due to a General Education structural overhaul mid-year: a 'Fall 2022' plan and an 'Effective Spring 2023' plan. This file uses the 'Effective Spring 2023' version (confirmed byte-for-byte identical to the single plan the 2023-24 archive shows -- see EMET-2023.json), since it's the version that governs students for nearly all of the year and carries forward unchanged into 2023-24. The alternate 'Fall 2022' Fayette plan differed only in pacing: it moved MATH 22 and CAS 100 into semester 1 spring in place of EGT 114 and MATH 140 (which shifted a term later), while using the identical course list and 4-year, 132-136-credit total otherwise -- a genuine but minor scheduling difference, not a curriculum difference, so not modeled as a separate file. REAL DIFFERENCES FROM THE 2026 (BEAVER) FILE: (1) this year's plan uses the MATH 210/MATH 211 'Calculus with Engineering Technology Applications' sequence instead of 2026's MATH 141/MATH 250 -- the bulletin's own Campus Advising Notes for Fayette explicitly say 'Students can substitute Math 141 and Math 250 for Math 210 and Math 211,' confirming these are a real, bulletin-sanctioned equivalent pair, not an error; this file uses the literal MATH 210/211 as printed for this year/campus. (2) this year's plan uses EMET 350 (3cr, 'Quality Control, Inspection, and Design') -- EMET 351 (the 2-credit alternate that appears starting in the 2024-25 archive, see EMET-2024.json) does not exist anywhere in the 2022-23 or 2023-24 Suggested Academic Plan text. (3) Total credits print as 132-136 here vs. 2026's flat 132. SAME REAL PREREQ GAP AS EMET-2026.json's OWN NOTES: EET 105's real prereq is MATH 21 (current math_catalog.json: prereq_groups=[['MATH 21']]), which this year's own bulletin table never lists either -- the exact same real, catalog-wide (not year-specific) gap EMET-2026.json's notes already document and fix. Likewise EET 212W really needs MATH 22 or MATH 82, and CMPSC 121 really needs MATH 110 or concurrent MATH 140. Fixed the same way 2026 was: added MATH 21, MATH 22, and MATH 110 to Semester 1. Unlike when 2026 was first built, MATH 21 currently carries no prereq of its own in math_catalog.json (empty prereq_groups), so no MATH 3/MATH 4 chain is needed here -- self-verification (below) confirms 0 'could not schedule' warnings with just this smaller fix. 'IET 333 or EET 215' pairing and 'EMET 351 (or General Education Course)' slots from the 2024-25+ plan do not appear in this year's plan at all -- 2022-23/2023-24 use plain IET 333 (2cr) instead. Slot credits (GEN ED ranges) are flattened to a single representative number from the printed range, same convention as 2026 and every other plan in this repo. 'etm' flags mirror EMET-2026.json's own choices for the same courses (MATH 26, MATH 140) -- this major's Suggested Academic Plan tab uses no '#' Entrance-to-Major symbol at all in any year checked (2022 through the live 2026-27 page), so these flags reflect the department's Program Requirements text, not a year-specific table symbol, and are unchanged across catalog years.
